card.name: Body surface area and p-values
card.fires_on: The word area(s) after 'body surface' or 'treatment surface' in dose comparisons, and the letter p in a statistical result in parentheses. Also fires on the start of a few other words such as Adjustment, incid and C(NS).

modes.label: Surface area
modes.description: The word area or areas right after 'surface' when doses are scaled by body size or when treatment area is discussed.
modes.example: which is approximately 18 times the MRHD of 60 mg/day on a body surface<< area>> (mg/m 2 ) basis.

modes.label: p in a p-value
modes.description: The letter p opening a significance value inside parentheses after trial event counts or confidence intervals.

modes.label: Start of a heading or term
modes.description: The first piece of a heading or abbreviation, such as Adjustment in a dosage heading or C in CNS.
modes.example: 2.4 Dosage<< Adjustment>> in Patients with Hepatic Impairment
